threshold_provenance: Derived in a clean-room rebuild from the CLAUDE.md hierarchy alone. CLAUDE.md names no numeric threshold, and its Patterns to Follow say never to invent one -- so every value here is UNCONFIRMED and must be set by a PT before it gates anything. Do not treat these as the v4 production values.

camera_guidance.side: Full body side-on; shoulder, hip and ankle all visible.
camera_guidance.front: Not recommended -- the body line cannot be judged head-on.

rep_signal.threshold_note: down_enter_deg is the REP-DETECTION gate and must sit ABOVE the depth fault threshold (partial_rom), or a too-shallow rep is never counted and the fault can never fire.
